title: Speaking — Staying in touch
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on staying in touch.

questions: What is a typical breakfast for you?
When do you usually eat your main meal?
Which meal of the day do you most look forward to?
Do you enjoy eating with several other people?
How do you normally arrange to meet friends?
Do you prefer brief messages or long calls?

part2.topic: Describe a conversation that helped you understand a friend better.
part2.closing: and explain why you remembered the conversation.

questions: What are the advantages of talking face to face about difficult issues?
Does frequent online contact make long-distance friendships easier to maintain?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to staying in touch?
